name: SVC_CHAT_PENDING_UWOS
description: This table is used to track realtime work (of type Chat) that has been accepted by an agent but cannot be routed (due to the corresponding Chat service session's CLIENT_ID not being available yet, for example).

columns.name: PENDING_UWO_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: CHAT_SESSION_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references SVC_CHAT_SESSIONS (CHAT_SESSION_ID), the Chat service session of the agent that accepted the chat.

columns.name: ENGAGEMENT_ID
columns.description: Id of the pending chat (as generated by the Chat service).

columns.name: WORK_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references SVC_WORK_OBJECTS (WORK_ID), the Omni work object corresponding to the chat.

columns.name: STATUS_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the status code of the chat pending work, such as PENDING, ACCEPTED, CANCELLED, EXPIRED.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the chat pending work is logically deleted (Y or N).

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
